entities.name: Allav Hask
entities.description: Captain, leader of four human soldiers on Dominaria, wielder of the Hand of Righteous Retribution.

entities.name: Hand of Righteous Retribution
entities.description: Powerful sword capable of channelling magical energy, said to be drawable only twice.

entities.name: Church of Angelfire
entities.description: Church whose High Primate is said to have blessed the Hand.

entities.name: Serrans
entities.description: Faction opposed by the Church of Angelfire.

entities.name: Vaan
entities.description: Pixie who enlisted Hask to kill a dragon.

entities.name: Tania Cayce
entities.description: Group member who knew how to kill the dragon and took the Hand.

entities.name: Dragon
entities.description: Dragon that killed some of Hask's men, linked to a draconic skeleton.

events.summary: Vaan enlists Hask to kill a dragon that had killed some of his men.
events.quote: He was enlisted by Vaan to kill a dragon.

events.summary: Hask damages the dragon with the Hand but is trapped under rubble when the lair collapses.
events.quote: Hask was trapped under the rubble

events.summary: Tania drugs Hask with a sleeping potion and takes the sword, apparently slaying the dragon.
events.quote: Tania gave Hask a sleeping potion and took the sword, apparently slaying the dragon with it

events.summary: Hask survives, with only one soldier and Boom; the Hand disappears in the chaos.
events.quote: The Hand of Righteous Retribution had disappeared in the chaos.

relations.note: Leader of the soldiers and golem.
relations.quote: Captain Allav Hask was the leader of a group of four human soldiers from Dominaria , including Trooper Fost , and the golem Boom .
his fellow group member Tania Cayce

relations.note: It killed some of his men.
relations.quote: As this dragon had killed some of his men
